title: SLR Engine — public evidence provenance
description: Provenance and data-sharing model for the public evidence release. Raw vendor records are NOT redistributed; see DATA_AVAILABILITY.md and docs/restricted-data.md.

data_sharing_model.public: Code, configs, queries, aggregate counts, paper identifiers, screening decisions, exclusion reasons, researcher-created extraction coding, synthetic fixtures.
data_sharing_model.controlled: Minimal derived records possibly containing limited, licence-cleared vendor metadata; institutional repository or post-approval GitHub only.
data_sharing_model.restricted: Raw Scopus/WoS exports, API responses, proprietary abstracts, citation lists, author affiliations/ids, downloaded PDFs, credentials. Retained in access-controlled storage; never in Git.

paper_id_scheme.description: Stable public paper identifier. Assigned deterministically, never copied from a vendor.

build_steps: Run `slr-engine scan-restricted` in CI and before tagging.
Owner runs `slr-engine build-public-data --master <external restricted CSV> --out-dir <repo>/public_data --force` from a controlled environment AFTER licence review.
The build script drops every column not in the public/controlled whitelist and refuses in-repo masters.
A fresh public clone plus `slr-engine verify-public` must pass offline with no restricted data present.
generated: This provenance record is a template; OWNER must fill the GitHub URL and the archived Zenodo software DOI before the MDPI submission.
